ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Underpass
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. A low continuous rush; occasional footsteps interrupt it and vanish before the next one.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Potting shed
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. The vessel fills in quick uneven taps, then one louder spill; long silence at the end.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Back stair
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. Two loose pipes seem to answer each other, sometimes at once; a distant door closes midway.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Window ledge
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. Fine ticks cover almost the whole recording; near the center several merge into a short scrape.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Empty basin
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. One heavy impact, a softer return, then smaller returns that become difficult to separate.

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Held Between — Service yard
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Fictional listening card. A steady high hiss sits behind irregular bursts; the bursts drift farther apart as the room empties.
